field.label: Enabled
field.help: Block the devices listed. Off, the rules are gone at the next filter reload; the list stays.

field.label: Log blocked packets
field.help: Write every packet the rules block to the firewall log.

field.label: Isolate devices that reach a command-and-control list
field.help: When os-netreport records that a device of your networks tried to reach an address on a command-and-control list that os-blocklists blocks, the device is isolated by its MAC address: nothing it sends passes the firewall and nothing reaches it through the firewall, for the time below, and its open connections are cut. Checked every minute, for connections in the last 10 minutes. Never the firewall itself, its gateways, its HA peer, an address with a connection open to its web GUI or SSH, or an address this page was opened from in the last 7 days; and never a MAC address several devices share (a repeater, a router). A device os-netreport knows no MAC address of is found by its address in the ARP or NDP table. Isolation is at the firewall: devices on the same switch still reach each other. Separate from the list of blocked devices and from Enabled above. Off by default.

field.label: Isolation time (hours)
field.help: How long a device stays isolated, from 1 to 720 hours; a shorter time set ends the isolations already running sooner. Undo on the Isolated devices tab lets a device go at once, and holds until its isolation would have ended.
